integrity: Proof, finite computation and reproducibility are supplied; results have received self-review only, not independent validation.
scientific_limitations: The minimum-degree classification is only for F_5; the smooth family covers characteristic p>3. The cubic nonexistence is certified by exhaustive finite enumeration with executable source. Earlier equivalent formulations may exist outside searched literature.
title: Smooth degree-\(q-1\) tangent pencils and the sharp \(\mathbb F_5\) threshold
